svg.title: FORGE3D method overview
svg.desc: Posed observations feed geometry latent forcing, which seeds the stage-1 sparse-structure flow. Visible voxels then receive observed DINOv2 features (appearance latent forcing) as the source of the stage-2 structured-latent flow, which is fine-tuned with correspondence-aware multi-view attention and decoded to a mesh. Illustrative diagram.

g.text: views that see each voxel supply its features
A soft bias steers each voxel query to
the patch it projects into (and its 3×3
The anchor view keeps full attention. With one
view the model equals the pretrained one.
